SANDEEP PATRA

Java Full Stack Developer (2.4Years Experience) Bengaluru, India Phone: +91-7208100301 Email: sandeep.patra0001@gmail.com GitHub: github.com/sandeep-patra1 LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/sandeep-patra1/

PROFILE SUMMARY

Java Full Stack Developer with 2.4 years of experience in designing and developing scalable, secure, and high-performance applications. Skilled in Java 17/21, Spring Boot, Microservices, RESTful Web Services, Angular 12+, SQL, PL/SQL, and AWS Cloud. Strong understanding of distributed systems, service-to-service communication, event-driven architecture, and cloud-native patterns. Hands-on experience with Spring Cloud (Eureka, Config Server, Spring Cloud Gateway, Feign Client), Circuit Breaker (Resilience4j), Docker, Kafka, Redis, and CI/CD pipelines. Proven ability to deliver end-to-end solutions covering requirement analysis, development, testing, deployment, performance optimization, and production support.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Programming Language: Java (17/21), SQL, PL/SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript Backend Technologies: Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring AOP, Interceptors, Filters, Spring Boot Actuator (Monitoring & Health Checks), Spring Cloud (Eureka, Config Server, Gateway, Feign Client), Microservices Architecture, RESTful Web Services (HATEOAS), Hibernate, JPA, Servlets, JWT Authentication

Frontend Technologies: Angular 12+, RxJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, AJAX, jQuery, JSP, JSTL Distributed Systems & Architecture: Distributed Systems, Load Balancing, API Gateway Pattern, Circuit Breaker Pattern (Resilience4j), Service Discovery, Asynchronous Communication, Event-Driven Architecture, Messaging Systems Security & Auth: Spring Security, OAuth2, SSO, JWT, Role-Based Access Messaging & Event Streaming: Apache Kafka (Producers, Consumers, Brokers, Topics, Partitions, Offsets) Performance & Scalability: Caching (Redis), Pagination, Batch Processing, Query Optimization, Connection Pooling Databases: Oracle, MySQL, Redis Tools: Oracle SQL Developer

Cloud & DevOps Tools: AWS (S3), Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Maven, CI/CD Pipelines Version Control: Git, SVN Testing: JUnit, Mockito, Postman Reporting Tools: Jasper Reports Development Practices: Agile, Scrum, Clean Code, Unit Testing

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Java Developer | IDBI Intech Ltd | June 2025 – Oct 2025

Key Contributions:

1. Developed and enhanced multiple microservices using Java 17, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs, improving response time by 30%.

2. Developed and deployed financial modules using Java and PL/SQL to support 10,000+ users.

3. Integrated Jasper Reports with Oracle DB, enabling real-time data reports and cutting manual effort by 40%.

4. Designed interactive Java desktop components using Swing and AWT for treasury operations.

Java Full Stack Developer | ApMoSys Technologies Pvt Ltd | May 2023 – April 2025

Key Contributions:

1. Developed scalable microservices using Spring Boot and deployed via Docker on AWS.

2. Migrated legacy applications from Java 8 to Java 17, improving performance by 30%.

3. Built REST APIs to support dynamic Angular frontends with 20% faster response times.

4. Collaborated with DevOps teams to automate CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, cutting release cycles by 50%.

5. Mentored junior developers and conducted code reviews, improving overall code quality by 18%.

6. Optimized SQL queries and database schema to enhance backend performance.

7. Implemented Spring Cloud Eureka, Config Server, API Gateway, and Feign Client to streamline inter-service communication.

8. Integrated Apache Kafka producers and consumers for asynchronous event-driven workflows, reducing synchronous dependencies.

9. Built scalable UI modules using Angular 12+, TypeScript, RxJS, improving user experience and reducing UI errors by 20%.

10. Optimized backend with pagination, query improvements, and Redis caching for faster data access.

11. Containerized microservices using Docker and deployed applications environments.

11. Containerized microservices using Docker and deployed applications environments.

12. Secured REST APIs using JWT-based authentication and Spring Security. Automated build and deployment processes using Maven, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines.

13. Configure with AWS S3 bucket for files storage.

PROJECTS

1. e-CSGL – IDBI Bank (IDBI Intech Ltd)

Tech Stack: Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, MySQL, Redis, Kafka

A "Constituent Subsidiary General Ledger Account" means a Subsidiary General Ledger Account opened and maintained with the Public Debt Office of the Reserve Bank of India, by a bank or an entity permitted by the Reserve Bank of India, for the purpose of holding and /or dealing in Government Securities on behalf of its constituents.

2. Sahara – (ApMoSys Technologies Ltd)

Tech Stack: Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, MySQL, Redis, Kafka

Collaborated with Ministry of Corporation to Develop this project with sole purpose to help people affected by SAHARA scam. This is a real-time user details process and verify the details with the different central government roles. Created microservices architecture using Kafka for bulk processing and Redis for session maintenance. Implement the payment module and Aadhar seed communication for validating user details. Created applications based on government role with technology Java(17), Spring Boot, and Angular(16).

3. Power Access H2H – Axis Bank – (ApMoSys Technologies Ltd)

Tech Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot, Oracle SQL, Angular 12, Docker, Kafka

An "Axis corporate portal" refers to an online platform provided by Axis Bank, allowing corporate clients to access and manage their banking accounts, view statements, initiate transactions, update information, and perform various financial operations securely through a dedicated web interface, essentially acting as a digital hub for managing their business banking needs with Axis Bank.

EDUCATION

B.Tech in Electronics and Telecommunication

Parala Maharaja Engineering College, Berhampur, 2022

CERTIFICATION

Java Full Stack Development at Jspider • TCS Youth Employment Program

sections.label: Projects
sections.text:
PROJECTS
1. e-CSGL – IDBI Bank (IDBI Intech Ltd)
Tech Stack: Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, MySQL, Redis, Kafka
A "Constituent Subsidiary General Ledger Account" means a Subsidiary General Ledger Account opened and maintained with the Public Debt Office of the Reserve Bank of India, by a bank or an entity permitted by the Reserve Bank of India, for the purpose of holding and /or dealing in Government Securities on behalf of its constituents.
2. Sahara – (ApMoSys Technologies Ltd)
Tech Stack: Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, MySQL, Redis, Kafka
Collaborated with Ministry of Corporation to Develop this project with sole purpose to help people affected by SAHARA scam. This is a real-time user details process and verify the details with the different central government roles. Created microservices architecture using Kafka for bulk processing and Redis for session maintenance. Implement the payment module and Aadhar seed communication for validating user details. Created applications based on government role with technology Java(17), Spring Boot, and Angular(16).
3. Power Access H2H – Axis Bank – (ApMoSys Technologies Ltd)
Tech Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot, Oracle SQL, Angular 12, Docker, Kafka
An "Axis corporate portal" refers to an online platform provided by Axis Bank, allowing corporate clients to access and manage their banking accounts, view statements, initiate transactions, update information, and perform various financial operations securely through a dedicated web interface, essentially acting as a digital hub for managing their business banking needs with Axis Bank.
